definitions.short: Jabneel , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H2995. Yabneel יַבְנְאֵל proper name, of a location ( El causeth to build ; compare יַבְנֶה בניהו, ) — 1 town in Judah Josh 15:11 ; ( ᵐ5 L Ἰαβνηλ ) = יַבְנֶה (q. v.) 2Chr 26:6 ; = Greek Iamnia , modern YebnaBd Pal 161. 2 town in Naphtali Josh 19:33 .
